def: a slope, i.e. (specially) a "clime" or tract of country

occurrences.text: But now having no more place in these parts, and having a great desire these many years to come unto you;
As the truth of Christ is in me, no man shall stop me of this boasting in the regions of Achaia.
Afterwards I came into the regions of Syria and Cilicia;

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
